PHASE.NAME: Token Economics And Proxy Runtime
PHASE.GOAL: Resolve FIX/M1, FIX/M2, FIX/M5, FIX/L4, and FIX/L1 by improving token accounting, tracker I/O, and proxy runner async behavior.

DATA_FLOWS.FLOW: Command output token estimates flow through M-UTILS into M-TRACKING and gain/session analytics with improved accuracy.
Proxy execution moves blocking process wait and capture into a bounded blocking task while async callers remain responsive.
Proxy capture cap and timeout settings flow from M-CONFIG into M-PROXY-RUNNER.

STEPS.step-1: Replace chars/4 token estimation with a deterministic improved estimator or tokenizer-backed implementation after dependency audit.
STEPS.step-2: Cache SQLite connection setup with WAL and busy timeout while preserving current tracker API behavior.
STEPS.step-3: Make command execution async-friendly through spawn_blocking and configurable capture caps/timeouts.
STEPS.step-4: Thread proxy runtime config into CommandRunner and preserve existing token tracking behavior.
STEPS.step-5: Remove unused project_db_path dead code if per-project DBs are not part of the active design.

RISKS.RISK: Tokenizer crates can add build weight or runtime data assumptions; dependency choice must keep release artifacts deterministic.
SQLite connection caching must not hold non-Send values across await points in unsafe ways.
